patch.summary: Hunter cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Hunter pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Hunter cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Hunter against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SMB and founder-led teams that need domain email finding, verification, and light campaigns requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
